resources.string: Runs your scripts when the IDE opens or closes a project, opens, saves or closes a file, or builds. Off until you turn it on.
Name an executable script after a hook, or put several in <hook>.d/. Scripts in actions/ appear as Run <name> on a file\'s menu. In the Terminal this folder is ~/.config/codeonthego/hooks.
Wrote %1$d sample files. Drop .sample from a name and make the file executable to use it.
Stop a script after this many seconds
Scripts in a project\'s .codeonthego/hooks folder run only after you read and trust them in the Hooks tab. Any plugin that can write files, or an AI agent, can put a script there.
Shell Hooks is off. Turn it on in Preferences, Shell Hooks.
Project scripts waiting for your review
This script is stored in the project %1$s. It runs with the same access as the Terminal, including the network. Trust it only if you have read it and know what it does.
This script is larger than %1$d KB, too large to review here. Read it in the editor; it will not run from here.
